entities.name: The Husk
entities.description: Crumbling ring of ruins around the southern Utvara valley on Ravnica, home of the nephilim and claimed by the Gruul.

entities.name: Gruul Clans
entities.description: Clans that claim parts of the Husk.

entities.name: Nephilim
entities.description: Five ancient, monstrous god-like beings of pre-Guildpact origin dwelling in the Husk.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: Guild whose experimental detonations destabilized the region.

entities.name: Zomaj Hauc
entities.description: Enemy in a battle after which the Husk was granted to the clans.

entities.name: Cauldron
entities.description: Destroyed in the battle with Zomaj Hauc.

events.summary: The Husk becomes increasingly unstable after the kuga plague and Izzet experiments, and the nephilim appear or reawaken.
After the battle with Zomaj Hauc and the Cauldron's destruction, the Husk is granted to the Gruul clans as sovereign territory.
events.quote: the Husk was granted to the clans as their sovereign territory

relations.quote: The Husk is also home to the nephilim
Various branches of the Gruul Clans lay claim to parts of the Husk
